2607.10803.title: Weight-Adjusted Gradients Reveal Parameter Importance and Failure Modes in LLMs
2607.10803.paper_summary: Understanding which parameters are influential in Large Language Models (LLMs) is central to improving their efficiency, reliability, and interpretability. We introduce Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG), a simple yet effective approach for estimating parameter importance that explicitly captures the interaction between model weights and first-order gradient information and identifies parameters that disproportionately influence model behavior, such as those responsible for collapse phenomena in LLMs. Across a range of models and settings, we show that WAG surfaces a tiny but critical subset of parameters whose modification leads to dramatic degradation in performance, a failure mode that existing importance metrics overlook. These findings reveal a previously underexplored interplay between weights and gradients, suggesting that parameter importance cannot be fully understood through either signal alone. The surprising effectiveness of WAG points to fundamental structural properties of trained networks and motivates new open questions about the role of zeroth-order and first-order information in deep learning. We demonstrate the practical utility of WAG across multiple applications, including expert allocation in mixture-of-expert architectures, parameter-specific unlearning, mixed-precision quantization, and layer selection for knowledge editing. Our results position WAG as a unified approach for analyzing, debugging, and controlling LLMs, and opens new directions for principled model-level interpretation.
2607.10803.paper_summary_zh: 理解哪些參數在大型語言模型（LLMs）中具有影響力，對於提高其效率、可靠性和可解釋性至關重要。<lb/>我們介紹了權重調整梯度（WAG），這是一種簡單但有效的估計參數重要性的方法，明確捕捉模型權重與一階梯度信息之間的相互作用，並識別那些不成比例地影響模型行為的參數，例如負責LLMs崩潰現象的參數。<lb/>在一系列模型和設置中，我們顯示WAG揭示了一個微小但關鍵的參數子集，這些參數的修改會導致性能的劇烈下降，而現有的重要性度量忽視了這種失效模式。<lb/>這些發現揭示了權重和梯度之間之前未被充分探索的相互作用，表明參數重要性不能僅通過單一信號來完全理解。<lb/>WAG的驚人有效性指向訓練網絡的基本結構特性，並激發了關於零階和一階信息在深度學習中角色的新開放問題。<lb/>我們展示了WAG在多個應用中的實用性，包括混合專家架構中的專家分配、參數特定的遺忘、混合精度量化以及知識編輯的層選擇。<lb/>我們的結果將WAG定位為一種統一的方法，用於分析、調試和控制LLMs，並為原則性的模型級解釋開辟了新的方向。
